name: Techstorm Advanced Material Corporation Limited
summary: Techstorm Advanced Material Corporation Limited engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sale of chemical products for wind turbine blades and new composite materialsin China and internationally. It offers adhesives; mold resin and various auxiliary adhesive systems; pultrusion, filament-winding, flame retardants, infusion, hand lay-up, and mold resin; cementing compounds, industrial adhesives, energy storage battery structural adhesives, and thermal conductive structural adhesives; and materials for battery, motor, and electric control systems.
